title: PlayBook AI: Basketball Intelligence
description:
Advanced video analysis software that classifies offensive and defensive basketball plays using computer vision and deep learning.

- 87.6% classification accuracy using temporal neural networks
- Custom YOLO object tracking model: 99.5% mAP50, 99.6% precision
- Spatial database with <80ms query response times
- Optimized AWS infrastructure, cutting compute costs by 63%

Product Goals: Help basketball professionals analyze offensive and defensive plays, assess player fit within a team, understand play patterns in critical moments, and identify a team's most/least successful plays.

title: Agentic Misalignment: Insider Threat Evaluation
description: An extension of Anthropic's research on agentic misalignment in LLMs ([How LLMs Could Be Insider Threats](https://www.anthropic.com/research/agentic-misalignment)). The framework systematically probes whether models engage in harmful agentic behaviors across three scenario classes — Blackmail, Information Leakage, and Goal Subversion — and runs against any LLM via API keys or Ollama, extending Anthropic's work with local model support and new scenario classes that further challenge LLM alignment.

title: Solace: Personal Data Archaeology
description: A personal data archaeology toolkit that analyzes what your apps track about you. OCEAN personality is an industry wide used methodology to track your behavioral data to profile consumers. This helps users understand what type of information others are collecting.

title: PS Local: Pokémon Showdown Battle Assistant
description: A local app that acts as a live Pokémon Battle Assistant. Leverages Pokémon Showdown protocols and codebase to develop a helper panel showing opposing Pokémon's predicted information in real time.
